## Memes (42)

- **Vine boom**: Realisation, shock, 'did he really just say that'. The universal punchline marker. Timing: Transient lands ON the reaction/punchline frame (frame 0 of the face or text). Freeze or hold 8-12 frames (0.27-0.4 s) at 30 fps, then cut. Never let it run under speech.
- **Bruh**: Disappointment at something dumb (yours or someone else's). Timing: Land 3-6 frames AFTER the fail frame so the fail reads first; hold a freeze 12-15 frames.
- **Metal pipe falling**: Absurd sudden fail; something falling that should not; chaos. Timing: Transient exactly on the contact frame; let the ring play over 20-30 frames of freeze or slow-mo.
- **"Emotional damage!" (Steven He)**: A roast landed; someone got verbally destroyed. Timing: Starts on the frame AFTER the insult finishes (no overlap with speech); freeze 20 frames.
- **Windows XP error / critical stop**: Something just broke: a bad take, a failed build, a wrong opinion. Timing: On the frame a fake error dialog pops in; dialog scales 0->100% over 4 frames with a spring overshoot (105%).
- **Windows XP shutdown**: Giving up, logging off, 'I'm done'. Timing: Start the chime on the last frame of the scene and cut to black on its final note (~60 frames).
- **Anime 'wow' / 'sugoi'**: Exaggerated amazement at something mundane. Timing: Begin 2 frames before the reveal so the vowel peaks on the reveal frame.
- **Phonk / Gigachad edit**: Aura, dominance, 'he's him'. Gym transformation and gaming highlight edits. Timing: Cut every 1/2 beat in the build, then on the drop: hard cut to the hero shot exactly on the first kick; flash 1 frame; slow-mo after.
- **Aura farming / aura points**: +1000 aura: calm flex, composure under pressure. '-500 aura' for a fail. Timing: Text '+1000 aura' pops on the downbeat (4-frame scale-in with overshoot); hold until next bar.
- **Super Saiyan power-up scream**: Gearing up for a max attempt; pre-workout kicking in. Timing: Riser starts ~2 s before the unrack; the scream peaks on the unrack frame; cut to the lift.
- **'Nah, I'd win' (Gojo, JJK)**: Confidence before facing something huge (a 3-plate deadlift, a boss, a 20-hour layover). Timing: Line ends 4-6 frames before the cut to the challenge; hold a stare 20 frames.
- **'Let him cook'**: Trust the process, he's onto something. Timing: Line drops when someone tries to interrupt; continue the action underneath.
- **GTA 'Wasted'**: Total failure / comic death. Timing: Slow down to 30-40% speed over 6 frames on the fail, desaturate to grey over 15 frames, 'WASTED' text lands at frame ~20 with the sting; hold 45 frames.
- **Minecraft damage 'oof' / Roblox 'oof'**: Small damage, mild pain, 'that hurt'. Timing: On the contact frame (bump, dropped dumbbell on foot, stubbed toe).
- **Mario coin**: Small win, money saved, +1. Timing: On the frame the item/price/rep counter appears; stack on each item in a list (min 6 frames apart).
- **Level-up fanfare (RPG)**: Progress, upgrade, new PR, new gear. Timing: Arpeggio's last note lands on the reveal (new PB on the bar display / new GPU in the case).
- **MLG hitmarker + airhorn**: Ironic 'pro gamer' montage (MLG 2014 parody). Timing: Hitmarker on each hit frame; airhorn bursts on the 3 beats after the play.
- **'Mission failed, we'll get 'em next time'**: Failed attempt, try again tomorrow. Timing: After the fail, black overlay fades in over 10 frames, line plays, text centred.
- **Among Us emergency meeting / 'sus'**: Someone is acting suspicious; betrayal. Timing: Hit on the frame you catch the 'imposter' (friend skipping leg day, someone eating your fries).
- **Secret discovered / item get**: Found something cool: a hidden cafe, a BIOS setting, a gym hack. Timing: Jingle's final note on the reveal frame; raise item over head (literally) for 30 frames.
- **PlayStation 1 / PS2 startup**: Nostalgia, boot-up, 'the setup is complete'. Timing: Swell starts at frame 0, logo-like reveal of your setup at the chime.
- **Taco Bell bong**: Dramatic emphasis on something stupid or suspicious. Timing: On the punchline frame; freeze 15-20 frames; let the tail ring.
- **'Fahhh'**: Missed it by THAT much: a near-miss, failed rep, missed shot, missed flight. Timing: Shout starts on the miss frame (ball hits post, bar stalls); freeze or slow-mo for the shout (~25 frames).
- **Censor beep**: Covers a swear; also implies a swear for comedy. Timing: Beep exactly spans the word (cut in on its first frame, out on its last); mute the original under it.
- **Coffin dance (Astronomia)**: Fatal fail, 'rest in peace'. Timing: Cut to the coffin-dance segment on the first synth hit after the fail.
- **'To Be Continued' (Roundabout)**: Cliffhanger right before a disaster. Timing: Song intro starts ~2 s before the fail; freeze on the frame before impact; sepia + 'To Be Continued' arrow slides in from the left over 8 frames.
- **Sad trombone ('wah wah wah waaah')**: Failure, game-show loss. Timing: Last long note on the fail freeze, 60 frames total.
- **Air horn**: Hype, celebration, MLG irony. Timing: Bursts on the beat right after the win, 3 x 8 frames.
- **Bonk**: Smack for a bad thought ('go to horny jail', 'stop it'). Timing: On contact frame; 3-frame squash on the target.
- **Wii Shop / Mii Channel music**: Calm browsing, shopping, waiting; ironic calm in chaos. Timing: Loop under shopping/building montage, duck -20 dB under voice.
- **Rizz sound ('boing' + eyebrow)**: Smooth flirt / smooth move. Timing: On the eyebrow raise / smooth line; 1 per video.
- **Cat laughing / 'huh' cat**: Laughing at a fail / confusion. Timing: 'Huh' on the frame the confusing thing is shown; laugh 12 frames after a fail.
- **'Sheesh'**: Impressed (a big lift, a clean build). Timing: Start on the reveal, let it run over a slow pan (~1.5 s).
- **'Omae wa mou shindeiru... NANI?!'**: You're already finished; shocked reaction. Timing: Calm line over a stare, 'NANI' on the hard zoom punch.
- **Hacker 'I'm in'**: Breaking into something trivial (BIOS, router settings, a jar lid). Timing: Typing for 30-60 frames, 'I'm in' on the frame the screen changes, then 1 click.
- **Startup chime (Mac / Windows boot)**: New build boots / first power-on. Timing: Chime on the exact frame the RGB/monitor turns on.
- **Crowd cheer / sitcom applause**: Celebration (ironic for small wins). Timing: Start on the success frame, fade out over 30 frames.
- **Glitch / data corruption**: System malfunction, brain lag, mind blown. Timing: Glitch spans 4-8 frames at the cut point.
- **'Just a chill guy' lo-fi**: Unbothered calm while chaos happens. Timing: Bed at -22 dB under VO, text 'just a chill guy' as the hook in frame 0.
- **Sigma stare / 'Rizzler' bass boosted**: Ironic 'sigma male' persona. Timing: Bass hit on the frame the stare begins; zoom 100->120% over 30 frames.
- **'Flawless victory' (Mortal Kombat announcer)**: Total domination with zero damage: perfect set, perfect build, perfect trip. Timing: Line starts on the final frame of the win (last rep locked, last cable tied); freeze 30-45 frames under it.
- **'C-C-C-COMBO BREAKER' (Killer Instinct)**: Someone interrupts your streak/flow (phone call mid-set, mom mid-game). Timing: On the frame of the interruption; 2-3 quick zoom punches on the stutter syllables (6 frames apart).
